name: Chang Wah Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Chang Wah Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops, produces, and sells LED lead frames and molding compound materials in Taiwan, Asia, and internationally. The company offers industrial plastic products and electronic components; IC-leaded and IC-non-lead frames; EMC and pre-mold lead frames; roughen and oxide surface plating treatment; resins materials; precision tools; and semiconductor materials. It also distributes machinery and tools; electronics; lighting materials and equipment; communication devices; semiconductor equipment; and electronic products.
